<ui-page>

    <ui-section id="features">
      <ui-container>
        <ui-heading level="2" align="center">Everything you need to think clearly</ui-heading>

          </ui-card>

          <ui-card>
            <ui-icon name="search" size="large"></ui-icon>
            <ui-heading level="3">Find anything</ui-heading>
            <ui-text>Search every note instantly with fast, intelligent full-text search.</ui-text>
          </ui-card>

          <ui-card>
            <ui-icon name="folder" size="large"></ui-icon>
            <ui-heading level="3">Stay organized</ui-heading>
            <ui-text>Use notebooks, tags, and favorites to keep your ideas exactly where they belong.</ui-text>
          </ui-card>

          <ui-card>
            <ui-icon name="cloud" size="large"></ui-icon>
            <ui-heading level="3">Sync everywhere</ui-heading>
            <ui-text>Access your notes seamlessly across your phone, tablet, and desktop.</ui-text>
          </ui-card>

          <ui-card>
            <ui-icon name="users" size="large"></ui-icon>
            <ui-heading level="3">Collaborate easily</ui-heading>
            <ui-text>Share notes and work together with your team in real time.</ui-text>
          </ui-card>

          <ui-card>
            <ui-icon name="shield" size="large"></ui-icon>
            <ui-heading level="3">Private by default</ui-heading>
            <ui-text>Your notes are encrypted and protected with security you can trust.</ui-text>

        <ui-grid columns="3" gap="large">
          <ui-card>
            <ui-heading level="3">Personal</ui-heading>

              <ui-list-item>Basic search</ui-list-item>
              <ui-list-item>Sync across 2 devices</ui-list-item>
            </ui-list>

          </ui-card>

          <ui-card featured="true">

            <ui-heading level="3">Pro</ui-heading>

              <ui-list-item>Offline access</ui-list-item>

          <ui-card>
            <ui-heading level="3">Team</ui-heading>
            <ui-price amount="15" currency="$" period="user/month">$15/user/month</ui-price>
            <ui-text>For teams that think together.</ui-text>
            <ui-list>

              <ui-list-item>Shared workspaces</ui-list-item>
              <ui-list-item>Real-time collaboration</ui-list-item>
              <ui-list-item>Admin controls</ui-list-item>
            </ui-list>
